title: Typed problem to tilted dashboard with stepped capabilities
summary: A caret types the pain on white, a short phrase types its accent word, the product name fades in, then a tilted dashboard card slides in and a pointer steps through three capability rows before the labels clear and one icon holds.
use_when: A service product whose story is one pain, one name, one dashboard
Silent feed teaser where typing carries the problem without VO
Showing three capabilities next to a single hero screen
Light, calm SaaS brands with one accent colour

look.type_style: medium geometric grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; typed lines ~4 % H, name line ~6 % H, list labels ~4 % H in grey; accent word in brand blue

sfx.event: pointer lands on a capability row

structure.shot: empty white frame, then a thin caret blinks left of centre
structure.motion: caret appears at 0.27 s, blinks ~2 Hz (±0.25 s); no other element

structure.shot: problem sentence, 6 words, typed in grey; the line scrolls left to keep the caret on screen
structure.camera: line pans left with the caret once it passes frame centre (from 1.77 s), easings.linear
structure.motion: typewriter ~22 chars/s measured from cells (±0.25 s); line scroll keeps caret near x 45 %; leaves by scrolling off left

structure.shot: short 3-word phrase centred, dark; its last word types in the accent colour
structure.motion: first two words present at 2.27 s, accent word typed ~10 chars/s over 15 fr (±0.25 s); hold 7 fr; exit fade to ~15 % opacity by 3.27 s, easings.outQuint ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: intro word + product name in accent, centred, larger; intro word leaves and the name recentres alone
structure.motion: line fades in 0.25 s (springs.ui, overshoot not measurable); intro word gone at 4.27 s and name slides to centre springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); name blurs out by 4.50 s

structure.shot: 2-word headline on the left, tilted dashboard card slides in from the right; headline is erased right to left
structure.camera: pull-out: card travels left and shrinks (motion.json zoom -18 %/s, pan -103 px/s in 5-6 s), easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: card enters from x 90 % at 4.77 s, springs.heavy ~30 fr; headline fades in with the card, backspace-erased from 5.50 s

structure.shot: card settled at left 60 % W; three capability rows (line icon + label, ruled dividers) fade in on the right
structure.motion: rows fade in top to bottom, stagger ~2 fr, easings.outQuint ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: accent pointer triangle appears left of the list and sits on row one; row one darkens and grows
structure.camera: card sways in tilt (rot -1.1 deg/s, pan y 37 px/s in 7-8 s), easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: pointer pops in springs.pop (overshoot not measurable); active row scale ~1.1 and colour grey to dark, springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: pointer steps to row two; row two active, row one back to grey
structure.motion: pointer slides down one row springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); active row swaps

structure.shot: pointer steps to row three; its bell icon and label go active
structure.camera: card sway (rot 3.5 deg/s in 8-9 s), settling
structure.motion: pointer slides down springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); hold 15 fr

structure.shot: pointer fades, labels clear one per row top to bottom, then the top two icons go; dividers and bell stay
structure.motion: labels fade out stagger ~7 fr, easings.outQuint ~6 fr (±0.25 s); icons follow at 10.00 s

structure.shot: hold: dashboard card at left, single accent bell icon on the right

params.phrase: 3-word restatement; last word typed in the accent colour
params.intro: one intro word before the product name
params.headline: 2-word positioning line next to the card
params.dashboard: one hero card: status line, title, 2 stat chips, logo, blurb, line chart
params.capabilities: 3 items {icon, label}, one verb each; the last icon holds at the end

notes: Zero cuts in 13.5 s: rows come from state changes in the sheets. Typing ~22 chars/s on the problem line, ~10 chars/s on the accent word. Catalogue hint card-grid not seen (one card only). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): caret-follow-scroll, pointer-step, label-clear.
